faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Common Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Reka Clip.

items.title: How do credits work?
items.description: Each video minute processed consumes one credit. HD clips cost an additional credit. Free tier includes 3 hours of video processing.

items.title: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.description: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your account settings. Your access continues until the end of your billing period.

items.title: What if clip generation fails?
items.description: If a generation fails, your credits are automatically refunded. Check the error message for details or contact support.

items.title: How long does processing take?
items.description: A 20-minute video typically takes about 4 minutes. Longer videos may take proportionally longer.

items.title: Can I use it for commercial projects?
items.description: Yes, all paid plans include commercial usage rights. Generated clips can be used for monetized content.

items.title: What languages are supported?
items.description: Reka Clip supports auto-captions in 80+ languages. You can customize caption style, position, and appearance.
